excerpt.zh:
对[from.GetName]的扫描追踪到了极端的气象现象，地表分布着零星但强烈的热脉冲。

需要进一步调查。
excerpt.en:
Scans of [from.GetName] are tracking extreme meteorological phenomena, with sporadic but intense heat spikes distributed across the surface.

This warrants further investigation.

texts.zh:
对[from.GetName]的细致调查发现了气象热脉冲的根源。

星罗棋布的地热喷口和间歇泉不断喷出高度易燃的气体，在大气中逐步累积。静电放电扮演起点燃催化的角色，导致爆炸性的气象锋面席卷整个星球的天空。

这些反应让我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]们对热动力燃烧获得了新的洞见，能在我们舰队的推进系统中加以应用
texts.en:
Detailed observation of [from.GetName] has revealed the cause of the meteorological heat spikes.

Geothermal vents and geysers across the surface are ejecting highly flammable gases which then accumulate in the atmosphere. Electrostatic discharges then act as an ignition catalyst, causing explosive weather fronts that ravage the skies of this world.

These reactions have given our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] new insights into thermodynamic combustion, with applications towards our own fleet's propulsion systems.

texts.zh: 不幸的是，这项危险的研究让[leader.GetName]受到严重的精神创伤。
texts.en: Unfortunately, the hazardous nature of this research has left [leader.GetName] with severe traumatization.

texts.zh: 不幸的是，这项危险的研究让[leader.GetName]受到严重的身体创伤。
texts.en: Unfortunately, the hazardous nature of this research has left [leader.GetName] with severe physical injuries.
